abilities.name: Tactical Versatility
abilities.text: Your training has prepared you for any circumstance. When you make a Critical Hit you may roll twice on the Critical Hit Table and choose either result.

abilities.name: Defender of Humanity
abilities.text: Add +Rank Icons to any successful attack against a Mob.

abilities.name: Honour the Chapter (Primaris)
abilities.text: You are subject to the orders of your chapter master, and must honour the beliefs and traditions of your chapter. Your Resolve increases by +1. As a Primaris, you ignore any impurities in your Chapter Gene-Seed, and also gain +3 Wounds.

abilities.name: Space Marine Implants
abilities.text: You are immune to the Bleeding Condition. You gain +1 bonus dice to any test related to one of the 22 implants (p.75) if the GM agrees it is appropriate.

abilities.name: Righteous Zeal
abilities.text: Your hatred permits you to show no mercy, nor does it permit you to yield while the enemy draws breath. When you charge, you may re-roll up to Rank dice on your Weapon Skill test. In addition, you may re-roll Rank dice when you roll Determination.

abilities.name: Background
abilities.text: Origin Courage (+1 Resolve); Accomplishment Crusader (+1 Determination); Goal Honour the Chapter (+1 Conviction). Determination is 6 (T 5 + 1).

talents.name: Bolter Discipline
talents.text: When you use a weapon with the BOLT Keyword, it gains the Rapid Fire (2) Trait. If the weapon already has the Rapid Fire Trait, add +Rank to the weapon's Rapid Fire rating.

talents.name: Built Tough
talents.text: You can use Survival (Wil) instead of Medicae (Int) to remove your own Wounds, Shock, or Conditions … You do not suffer the usual DN penalties for using this ability on yourself.

gear: Storm Shield (Core pp.232–233): AR *2. Shield: +2 Defence and Resilience when the GM agrees it blocks. Power Field: Determination vs Mortal Wounds. Bulk (1): −1 Speed
Duelling Grip on the Power Maul (Rubicon Uncommon item, Core p.228): +1 bonus die on Attack Tests using this weapon
Kraken Bolt rounds (AP −2, Core p.231; BOLT weapons only)

detail.personality: Speaks only in scripture. He stands in the breach so no brother has to, and treats every xenos as an error to be corrected.

objectives.text: Chapter: let no xenos artefact leave Volkus intact.
Secret: stop the Magos taking anything from the crypt.
